narrative.benchmark_md: Peer set locked in research Batch 1: Cullen/Frost (CFR, $53B), Prosperity Bancshares (PB, $40B), Comerica (CMA, $78B), Western Alliance (WAL, $80B), Pinnacle Financial Partners (PNFP, $56B). TCB ($32.5B) is the smallest peer group member by assets but the fastest-growing by ROATCE improvement trajectory. Peer scores at CATEGORY LEVEL (not capability) — all peer scores are T3 quality based on public disclosures and analyst research.
narrative.issue_register_md: BORROWED FROM RESEARCH REPORT (DMA-RES-TCB-20260511-0001, Section 5) — enriched with scoring impact annotations for the assessment layer. No MATERIAL or CRITICAL severity issues were identified. Six MINOR issues create cap triggers that constrain specific capability scores (detailed in Appendix B Handoff Package). Clean regulatory history is documented through negative search evidence.

per_pillar_md.P1: TCB sits below peer median across all four pillars, with the notable exception of Cybersecurity (+0.07 above peer median). The narrowest gap is P4 Data/Technology (−0.20), making it this area where Zennify's recommendations will produce the fastest measurable improvement. The widest gap is P1 Strategy/Culture (−0.76), where internal evidence (eNPS, change management programs) is required for accurate assessment rather than additional technology investment.
